description: This file defines the FastMath class, providing a high-performance, accurate alternative to java.lang.Math for large-scale computations. It includes mathematical constants, functions for exponential, logarithm, hyperbolic functions, power, and trigonometric functions, often with enhanced precision and additional methods not available in standard Java Math.

classes.name: FastMath
classes.description: Provides static methods for advanced mathematical computations, optimized for speed and accuracy, including hyperbolic functions, logarithms, exponentials, power functions, and trigonometric functions, with additional methods for precision and edge cases.

classes.name: ExpFracTable
classes.description: Contains the exponential fraction tables (A and B) used for approximation of exp(x/1024) over 0-1 interval. Tables are lazily loaded, either via runtime computation or preloaded arrays.

classes.name: lnMant
classes.description: Contains extended precision logarithm tables over the range 1-2, loaded on first access, used for high-precision log computations.

classes.name: CodyWaite
classes.description: Implements Cody/Waite argument reduction technique for accurate sine, cosine, and tangent calculations in trigonometric functions. Performs range reduction by estimating k and computing remainders with high precision.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the square root of a number, delegating to Math.sqrt.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cosine of a number with enhanced precision and special case handling.

methods.name: sinh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic sine of a number with optimized approximation techniques.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a number, handling large values efficiently.

methods.name: acosh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic cosine.

methods.name: asinh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic sine using piecewise approximation.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Calculates the inverse hyperbolic tangent with rational polynomial approximation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of a number, delegating to built-in functions with special case handling.

methods.name: log1p
methods.description: Calculates log(1 + x) with precision enhancements for small x.

methods.name: log10
methods.description: Calculates the base-10 logarithm.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Calculates x raised to the power y with special cases for edge inputs and high precision algorithms.

methods.name: exp
methods.description: Calculates e raised to the power x, with internal table lookups and polynomial approximations.

methods.name: expm1
methods.description: Calculates exp(x) - 1 with high accuracy for small x, using polynomial approximations.

methods.name: signum
methods.description: Returns the sign of the number: -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: nextUp
methods.description: Returns the next representable floating-point value greater than the argument.

methods.name: nextDown
methods.description: Returns the next representable floating-point value less than the argument.

methods.name: random
methods.description: Returns a pseudo-random number between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: sin
methods.description: Computes sine of the argument, involving argument reduction and quadrant handling.

methods.name: cos
methods.description: Computes cosine of the argument, involving argument reduction and quadrant handling.

methods.name: tan
methods.description: Computes tangent of the argument, with argument reduction and special case handling.

methods.name: atan
methods.description: Computes arctangent of the argument, with argument reduction and polynomial approximation.

methods.name: atan2
methods.description: Computes phase angle of point (x,y), handling all quadrants and special cases.

methods.name: asin
methods.description: Computes arcsine with input validation and precision adjustments.

methods.name: acos
methods.description: Computes arccosine with input validation and precision adjustments.

methods.name: cbrt
methods.description: Computes cubic root with normalization, polynomial approximation, and Newton's method refinements.

methods.name: toRadians
methods.description: Converts degrees to radians with high accuracy, splitting input to reduce error.

methods.name: toDegrees
methods.description: Converts radians to degrees with high accuracy, splitting input to reduce error.

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Absolute value functions for int, long, float, double.

methods.name: ulp
methods.description: Computes the unit in the last place (ULP) for double and float types.

methods.name: scalb
methods.description: Multiplies a number by a power of two, handling special cases and normalization for double and float types.

methods.name: nextAfter
methods.description: Provides the next floating-point number toward a target value, handling special cases for double and float.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Returns the largest double less than or equal to input.

methods.name: ceil
methods.description: Returns the smallest double greater than or equal to input.

methods.name: rint
methods.description: Rounds to the nearest integer, with tie-breaking rules.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Computes the closest long or int to a double or float input.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Computes the minimum of two values for int, long, float, double.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Computes the maximum of two values for int, long, float, double.

methods.name: hypot

methods.name: IEEEremainder
